entries.speaker: Researcher
entries.en: Is the medicine still affecting you?

entries.speaker: Secretary
entries.en: Should we get him to a hospital?

entries.speaker: Private Doctor
entries.en: We should probably wait and see[n]a little longer...
entries.uk: Мабуть, варто ще трохи почекати[n]й подивитися...

entries.speaker: Researcher
entries.en: Did the temporary-death serum not work?

entries.speaker: Young Shido Lackey
entries.en: If he's had a change of heart, will he blab[n]everything about us?
entries.uk: Якщо йому змінили серце, він же[n]розбовкає все про нас?

entries.speaker: Secretary
entries.en: What are we supposed to do about his[n]campaign?
entries.uk: А що нам робити з його кампанією?

entries.speaker: Young Shido Lackey
entries.en: Announce that he's not feeling well!

entries.speaker: Senior Shido Lackey
entries.en: Arrange a hospitalization in absolute[n]secrecy! Don't let anyone near him!
entries.uk: Влаштуйте госпіталізацію в цілковитій[n]таємниці! Нікого до нього не пускати!

entries.speaker: Young Shido Lackey
entries.en: Dammit, we have to do something...
